note: MEASUREMENT ONLY. src/energy.py is not modified. Two populations are produced from the same audio with the same parameters: 'current' uses the shipped _merge_short_runs, 'artefact_free' uses a local variant in which a first segment that is a silence shorter than min_silence_s is merged forward into the segment that follows it instead of being kept unconditionally.

watcher_probe.note: imported rather than copied so the watcher numbers here and the committed 673 runs / 1671 events cannot drift apart

populations.artefact_free: local variant in this file; the first segment is no longer kept unconditionally -- a first-segment silence shorter than min_silence_s is merged forward into the segment that follows it

narration.note: the watcher re-segments a MOVING buffer, so 'the first segment' is the segment at the buffer origin, not the start of the file; the defect therefore fires once per BUFFER whose origin lands in a short silence, which is why the whole-file population (3 leading silences) understates it
